stem: Voltmarkt's accessories campaigns meet their 400% ROAS target, yet finance says they lose money. Accessories carry a 20% gross margin. Which explanation fits these numbers?

options.text: A 400% ROAS means each €1 of spend brings back only €0.40 of revenue
ROAS divides spend by revenue, so a higher figure is a worse result
A 20% gross margin means a fifth of all revenue goes to paying for ads
Each €1 of spend brings €4 of revenue but only €0.80 of gross profit
